name: Object Interaction Graph
description: Which object types act together, and how — a Promenade Relational Program built specifically on OCEL 2.0's E2O/O2O relations and qualifiers, the part of the logical schema a Traditional Event Log simply does not have. Second reference action for the Promenade Relational API, after core.discover-dfg-sql.

minSharedEvents.title: Minimum shared events
minSharedEvents.description: Two object types are drawn as connected only once they co-occur on at least this many events.
